## Frozen scientific authority

**Scientific authority frozen; implementation conformity not yet assessed
under this contract.** Scientific owner: Grant Wilson acting for SCI-PTC.
Freeze date: 2026-09-06. Exact scientific identity: **SCI-PTC-COEFFICIENT-UNIFORM v0.1-draft.1 / r0.4**.

[The freeze manifest](FREEZE_MANIFEST_R0.4.json) binds the approved common
source, both unchanged PDF views, crosswalks, brief, decisions, original
artifact inventory and independent post-owner consistency PASS. Promotion is
a byte-preserving relocation, not a scientific revision. The `v0.1` package
directory and stable PDF filenames organize this exact authority; they do
not rename the approved scientific identity or any literal `@draft-0.1` key.
Original underscore entrypoint/PDF names in preserved crosswalks resolve by
the manifest's explicit original-to-canonical mapping. Archived copies in the
study are provenance; this manifest identifies the one promoted authority.

[DECISION_LOG.md](DECISION_LOG.md) and the exact owner approval supersede only
historical pending/open/inactive wording in the approved bytes. All fourteen
UFC-OD proposals and UFC-Q-001 are resolved as approved; the five UFC-DEF
subjects remain deferred. The historical decision ledger is not rewritten.

Registry and consumer boundary admission are bound separately in
[the acceptance package](../../../acceptance/PTC_UNIFORM_R04_2026-09-06/README.md).
They supply exact scientific permission and source identities, not a runtime
realization, default, complete numerical route or implementation acceptance.
Frozen PTC r0.5 remains the parent; MAP and JINC retain separate consumer gates.
